Hello, everyone! Welcome to our latest update, where we share the recent progress and improvements in the game.

[/p][h2]What’s New[/h2][list][*][p]​We’ve made several under-the-hood upgrades to improve combat stability and performance.[/p][/*][*][p]To better support upcoming features around story engagement and rewards, story nodes now require energy to play.[/p][/*][*][p]The map now remembers your last played node and auto-focuses on it.[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial has been simplified for a smoother start.[/p][/*][*][p]Energy potion UI has been improved for clarity.[/p][/*][*][p]UI scaling issues have been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Application stability improved when minimizing or switching windows.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor visual improvements to a cutscene.[/p][/*][*][p]New icons added to the character customizer.[/p][/*][*][p]Ongoing work on a new character shader for future flexibility.[/p][/*][*][p]We've boosted rewards across multiple daily and weekly missions, plus added [b]energy potion drops[/b] to give you more ways to keep playing!


[/p][/*][/list][h2]What We’re Working On[/h2][list][*][p]New 3-Star Mementos are in development![/p][/*][*][p]More level environments​[/p][/*][*][p]A Rewards Calendar is coming: log in every day to earn something new![/p][/*][*][p]We're also building a Reward Track system: complete missions, climb reward tiers, and collect big prizes![/p][/*][*][p]New outfits for main characters are being designed.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181394/4f43c662c831842c7536cbe16e7315425e6ee36e.png"][/img]

Hello, everyone! Welcome to our latest update, where we share the recent progress and improvements in the game.

[h2]What we’re working on[/h2]

[h3]Finished Updating Tutorial UI[/h3]
Last week we began work on improving the Combat Tutorial UI. We've finally finished it and made it available to players.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181394/1e34f3bcd2b08e8685c7a399b383fda04a37614e.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181394/f32f7e7d9f009d7032c387761418008c3295596f.gif[/img]


[h3]More Robust Choice System[/h3]
You can make choice callbacks in subsequent dialogue and the system handles redoing choices, as well as allowing you to go back to previous dialogue.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181394/3ac659d9441aa58e2c26fd1dfa573d0538206780.gif[/img]
